description_en: Queries the details of a compliance package in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内合规包详情
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-compliance-pack --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

parameters.help_zh:

CompliancePack.description_en: The details of the compliance package

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account to which the compliance package belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 合规包归属的管理账号ID

CompliancePackName.description_en: The name of the compliance package

ConfigRules.description_en: The list of rules in the compliance package

ConfigRuleName.example: 弹性IP实例带宽满足最低要求

ParameterName.description_en: The name of the rule parameter

ParameterValue.description_en: The value of the rule parameter

Required.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameter is required in the rule. Valid values:
true: Required.
false: Not required
Required.description_zh:
规则中参数是否必填。取值：
true：必填。
false：非必填

Description.example: 弹性IP实例可用带宽大于等于指定参数值，视为“合规”。默认值：10 MB。

ResourceTypesScope.description_en: The resource types evaluated by the rule. Multiple resource types are separated by commas (,)
ResourceTypesScope.description_zh: 规则评估的资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: High risk.
2: Medium risk.
3: Low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the compliance package was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 创建合规包的时间戳。单位：毫秒

Description.description_en: The description of the compliance package
Description.example: 基于等保2.0三级标准，提供持续检测合规性的建议模板，帮助您提前自检并修复问题，以便快速通过正式检测。

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the compliance package. Valid values:
1: High risk.
2: Medium risk.
3: Low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

Scope.description_en: The evaluation scope of the compliance package

ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_en: The excluded regions. Multiple region IDs are separated by commas (,)
ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_zh: 排除的地域范围，多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package does not take effect on resources in the specified resource group IDs. Multiple resource group IDs are separated by commas (,)
ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源不生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package does not take effect on the specified resource IDs. The specified resources are not evaluated
ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估

RegionIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources in the specified region IDs
RegionIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效

ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources in the specified resource group IDs
ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效

ResourceIdsScope.description_en: The rule takes effect on the specified resource IDs. Multiple resource IDs are separated by commas (,)
ResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

TagKeyScope.description_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources that are bound with the specified tag key
TagKeyScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键的资源生效

TagValueScope.description_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources that are bound with the specified tag key-value pair
TagValueScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键值对的资源生效

Status.description_en:
The status of the compliance package. Valid values:
ACTIVE: Normal.
CREATING: Being created
Status.description_zh:
合规包状态。取值：
ACTIVE：正常。
CREATING：创建中

TemplateContent.description_en: The template information of the current compliance package. The rule list in the template does not include custom function rules. You can use this template information to quickly create the same compliance package for other accounts or account groups
TemplateContent.description_zh: 当前合规包模板信息，模板中规则列表不包含自定义函数规则。可基于模板信息快速为其他账号或账号组创建同样的合规包
